notes.text: The source has Akiva’s journey and Neḥemyah finding him. Heilprin inverts the expression “met” and uses years generically.
The compressed Hebrew leaves the speaker unstated. In the underlying Mishnah Neḥemyah names Yehudah, and Akiva agrees. Remove the unsupported assignment of the report to Akiva.
The elder’s tradition is explicitly one-witness remarriage testimony; the Mishnah gives no date for when he established it.
